messages.subject: Lunchtime CLE: Recent developments in warranty & indemnity insurance
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

Join us on Thursday 21 May at 12:30 in the 8th-floor training room for a one-hour CPD session on recent developments in W&I insurance on private M&A and growth equity deals, presented by guest speaker from Lockton. Sandwiches provided. 1 hour CPD.

Please RSVP via the learning portal.

Best wishes,
Knowledge & Learning Team
